name: Deployment status to Teams Adaptive Card (Preview)
description:
## What it does

Receives the deployment callback sent by the repository GitHub Actions deploy workflow and renders its job, environment, image, namespace, Helm release, and run link as an Adaptive Card using **Webhook → Code → DevX Message Connector**.

## Setup

1. Add a **DevX Message Connector** credential containing the full Teams channel link and configure `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL` and `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_KEY`.
2. While editing, POST a deployment payload to `/webhook-test/devx/deployment-status` and inspect the Preview response.
3. Activate the workflow and point `DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL` or `REPO_DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL` at `/webhook/devx/deployment-status`. Change **Mode** to **Send** only after reviewing the card.

## Notes

Preview calls `<DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL>/api/v1/messages/preview` without posting to Teams; it is not an offline transformation mode. The Webhook responds immediately, so acceptance does not confirm Teams delivery. The Code node is the exact script from the [source runbook](https://bcgov.github.io/common-hosted-workflow/ci-cd/cd/deployment-status-notifications), which documents success, failure, and cancellation fields. No credentials or pinned execution data are included.
